facts.value: ASU offers merit-based scholarships for international first-year and transfer students. You are automatically considered when you apply for admission — no separate application is needed.
Tuition and fees vary depending on your program. You can estimate your total cost using ASU's cost of attendance calculator.

ASU may offer conditional admission to international applicants who meet the academic (aptitude) requirements but who are not proficient in English. Conditional admission gives international F-1 students three semesters to submit a passing TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score, or to successfully graduate from ASU Global Launch to be fully admitted to the university.
ASU offers several English proficiency exemptions for applicants who meet certain criteria.
A score of at least 550 (PBT) or 80 (iBT). ASU’s institutional code is 4007.
An overall band score of at least 6.5.
Most first-year students live on campus. You'll apply for housing after paying your enrollment deposit. Residence halls are assigned by major and campus location.
I-20 delivery option, Financial guarantee form, Financial document (bank statement or financial support letter), Foreign SEVIS address, Copy of passport, SEVIS transfer form (if applicable).

Your academic credentials must provide information on the courses you took each year and the grades or marks received. Any document ASU receives becomes the property of the university and will not be returned to you.
All international transcripts must be submitted in the original language accompanied by an official English translation. Translations must be literal, complete versions of the originals.

Transcripts and supporting documents should be uploaded in My ASU or sent electronically through your school or a transcript service. For physical mail, visit admission.asu.edu/apply/transcripts for mailing instructions.
